name: ghost_steamboat
notes: A sternwheel paddle steamer, 31 m long with the wheel, 7.5 m in the beam and 16 m to the stack tops: the Belle Marrow, lost in the flood of the old century. Hull with a spoon bow, an open freight deck and engine room, a boiler-deck saloon with staterooms, the texas and pilothouse above, two black stacks and a red paddle wheel at the stern; lamps in every window. Doors are 1 m by 2 m, stairs lead up the bow and both sides. Bow to local -Z. Base sea.
